SGP4XP.description: Simplified General Perturbation Model 4 eXtended Perturbations (SGP4-XP), as published in the 2022 astrodynamics conference literature.

AP.description: SDN Advanced Propagator (AP): an advanced propagator that builds on the entire history of astrodynamics (NRLMSISE-00 drag on the day's space weather; tesseral and zonal gravity terms). Its sets fly only on AP. 4 is left unused: it was a cut value of an earlier theory.

UNSPECIFIED.description: Not stated. A reader of an element set refuses UNSPECIFIED by name: the theory of a set is always written.
